    AI Mode replied:

    You can find and download high-resolution photos, vector graphics, and wallpapers of the Indian national flag (Tiranga) from several popular stock and inspiration platforms: 
    • Free Stock Photos & Videos: Browse over 10,000 pictures, vector assets, and clips on Pexels Stock Photos or explore community-driven free imagery on Unsplash Indian Flag Pictures. 
    • Creative & Commercial Assets: Access hundreds of thousands of illustrations, 3D renders, and waving flag graphics via Adobe Stock Indian Flag Images or editorial photos on Getty Images Indian Flag. 
    • Wallpapers & Design Ideas: Find aesthetic pictures, phone DPs, and poster backgrounds on
      Pinterest Indian Flag Ideas.
       
    Design of the Flag
    • Tricolor Bands: Three horizontal rectangular bands of equal size featuring deep saffron (top), white (middle), and India green (bottom).
    • Ashoka Chakra: A navy blue wheel with 24 spokes centered on the white band, representing the wheel of law (Dharma).
    • Proportion: The standard flag ratio is 3:2 (length to width). 
    If you are looking for something specific—such as high-definition wallpapers, PNG files with transparent backgrounds, or vector files for printing—let me know and I can point you to the right resource.
